verdict.rationale: The homepage shows a visa-recommendation style output ('O-1A Extraordinary Ability Recommended / EB-1A Self-Petition Strong / H-1B Cap Subject Backup'), which hints at an assessment, and Alma publishes O-1A/O-1B/EB-1 eligibility guides and client-portal questionnaires. However, none of this confirms a free, self-serve, structured qualifier on the site; the guides are articles, and the questionnaires are part of a paid engagement. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a free self-serve O-1/EB-1 eligibility tool, a description of its structured criteria scoring, confirmation it's free and doesn't need a consultation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
